## Prior-resolution disposition

Hayman Problem 4.15 is resolved by Oren Yakir's published 2021 result. This edition verifies the exact implication from the version-pinned theorem to the target family.

For H(z) = sum from k = 1 to n of epsilon_k z^k, set Q(z) = H(z)/z. Multiplication by z adds exactly one simple zero in the open unit disc. Yakir's exceptional probability tending to zero therefore gives the uniform tolerance n^(9/10) + 1 outside o(2^n) target polynomials, with zeros counted with algebraic multiplicity.

Credit for the resolution belongs to Yakir. The inspected technical statement is Theorem 1 of arXiv:2011.06234v2 (24 January 2022); official metadata confirms the 2021 journal publication and matching conclusion, DOI [10.4064/sm201117-28-1](https://doi.org/10.4064/sm201117-28-1). The journal typeset PDF was not acquired or compared with arXiv.

This is a complete statement-to-target transfer conditional on the cited theorem, not an independent validation of its whole proof. Algebraic multiplicity, open-disc/boundary limits, all-integer asymptotics, and the apparent p.5 proof-text issues remain explicit. No source-text correction, novelty, formal verification, or human peer review is claimed.

## Contents and verification

- Eight addition-only files under `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/2304015/`: full authored certificate, source ledger, sanitized source metadata, acceptance/status, edition guide, provenance, and payload manifest.
- The complete mathematical body and public references are byte-preserved. Editorial changes remove queue rank and obsolete workflow-only language and normalize metadata spacing and a heading's punctuation.
- Both raw public-PDF byte counts and SHA-256 hashes were independently rechecked against the source audit. Source retrieval and inspection history are retained; packaging performed no new PDF download or whole-manuscript audit.
- Payload manifest, exact file allowlist, local links, UTF-8/JSON, and clean temporary addition-only replay passed local verification. These checks establish packaging integrity, not hosted-CI success.
- Zero proof-search approaches and zero proof turns. No `QUEUE.md` or unrelated repository changes.
